title: Simply Rudimentary
description: This modpack purely brings a cozy feel to minecraft by adding allot of aesthetic mod to the game with a handfull of mods that add new content.
body:
[![kinetic hosting](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f3e5234712d32562be999b307b425ca6286f4b8e_0.webp)](https://billing.kinetichosting.com/aff.php?aff=1433)

This modpack adds the pure feeling of cozyness to minecraft. It focusses on adding peacefull stuff rather then stuff for pvp. The modpack also revolves around Simply Cozy, a small but very cozy mod that ive developed. 

The modpack adds various things to the game like:

**Visually:**
- 3D Skin Layer
- Chat Heads
- Coffee Gui
- Better Stat Screen
- Ambient sounds
And way more!!!

**New Content:**
- Simply Cozy
- Simply Enchantments

**Performance:**
- Sodium
- Immidiatly Fast
- Lithium
- Ferrite Core
- Entity Culling
And more!!!

**Q&A:**

Q: Is this modpack light weight?

A: Yes, ive tested it on a school laptop and i got a stable 60-50 FPS on the default settings!

Q: Is there a wiki to find info on this modpack or mods?

A: Yes, https://simplycozy.miraheze.org/wiki/Main_Page

DISCLAIMER: ive NOT made all mods in this modpack, i did make some but i dont get full credit for the full modpack
